translations.web: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
translations.bsb: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
translations.kjv: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
translations.asv: Jehovah knoweth the days of the perfect; And their inheritance shall be for ever.
